title: Scaffold crates/apricity-daw with the export_set entry point and a README layout row
description:
## Intent

Create the crate that writes DAW files, so the set export (and later `.alc`/`.adg` from apricitus-5562e0 and apricitus-d7746d) share one writer.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/` with `Cargo.toml` (workspace package fields; deps: `apricity-score`, `flate2`, `quick-xml`; dev-deps: `cucumber = "0.21"`, `tokio`, `tempfile`, `hound`), `src/lib.rs` with the public entry point `export_set(timeline: &Timeline, opts: &SetOptions) -> Result<SetExport, Vec<String>>`, where `SetExport` holds the XML bytes, the list of files to collect (source → project-relative path) and warnings. No file I/O in the crate beyond what tests do.
- Workspace: add `apricity-daw` to `[workspace.dependencies]` in the root `Cargo.toml`.
- README.md Layout table: a row for `crates/apricity-daw`.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo build -p apricity-daw` and `cargo doc -p apricity-daw --no-deps` succeed; `git grep -n apricity-daw README.md` shows the row.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): apricity-daw crate for writing DAW sets`. Not breaking.
